title: truss project config
description: <repo>/.claude/truss.json, read by truss's skills and agents; the hooks don't read it. truss init writes architecture and adr, and from 0.4.0 proposes roles, deploy, writingSkill and promptOverrides, writing them only after the client approves (truss ADR-0002). Every key but architecture and adr is optional and has a default. A reader reports each problem to the client once and never treats one as fatal. It ignores a key this schema doesn't declare and unsets a value the schema rejects, so its default applies; inside roles and promptOverrides it unsets only the bad entry, and deploy fails closed: any error inside it, an undeclared key included, unsets the whole deploy key, and production is never defaulted to false. init keeps what the client wrote, errors included, and reports them by path (truss ADR-0002).

architecture.description: The architecture doc, relative to the repo root.

adr.description: The ADR directory, relative to the repo root.

featureMap.description: 0.23.0. The feature map, relative to the repo root, that the crew knowledge step updates (truss ADR-0033). Default docs/features.md. A path inside the repo: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash or .. segment.

adrDir.description: 0.23.0. The directory the crew knowledge step writes decision ADRs to, relative to the repo root. Default: the adr key, else docs/adr. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

productDecisions.description: 0.24.0. The file that holds the crew product calls, relative to the repo root (truss ADR-0035). Default docs/knowledge/product-decisions.md. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

knowledgeDir.description: 0.24.0. The directory of lazy knowledge docs (one topic per file, frontmatter sources and verified), relative to the repo root. Default docs/knowledge. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

rulesDir.description: 0.24.0. The directory of path-scoped rule files (frontmatter paths, sources, verified), relative to the repo root. Default .claude/rules. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

agentsIndex.description: 0.24.0. The always-loaded index of pointers that CLAUDE.md imports with @AGENTS.md, relative to the repo root. Default AGENTS.md. A path inside the repo, as featureMap is.

knowledgeBudgets.description: 0.24.0. Line budgets that knowledge-lint checks (truss ADR-0035). Defaults: agentsIndex 60, persona 120, personaStandards 15 (list items under ## Standards), rule 40, featureEntry 6, doc 150. Over budget is a failure for agentsIndex, persona, personaStandards and rule (always-loaded files) and a warning for featureEntry and doc.

agentCap.description: Deprecated and ignored since truss 0.7.0. Still accepted so older configs validate.

reworkAllowance.description: How many fresh QCs a crew may start after QC FAILs in one run, copied into a v2 plan.json. Default 2.

maxParallelCrews.description: The most crews running at once. Default 4.

merge.description: Merge mode of every run; the PM never asks. Default sequential.

target.description: Target branch of every run; the PM never asks. Default: the current branch.

roles.description: 0.4.0. Which agent type does each kind of crew work, by job, not by character. The PM uses a listed type when the session can start it, and otherwise picks from its inventory as in 0.3.0. A job left out is picked from the inventory. The QC, checking engineer, project manager and design engineer are always truss's own and can't be mapped.

deploy.description: 0.4.0. How the project deploys, for the commissioning engineer's brief. A deploy to a target with production true always goes to the client first, whatever else is configured.

writingSkill.description: 0.4.0. A skill the writer member loads with the Skill tool before it writes, such as technical-writer. Used only when the session lists it; otherwise the writer says so and carries on.

promptOverrides.description: 0.4.0. Per truss role, a prompt file in the project whose instructions the role reads in addition to its own prompt. The brief names the file; it never replaces the role's prompt, and this file never holds prompt text (P21). The hooks' rules and each role's report format still hold.

notify.description: 0.25.0. A client-owned shell command run one-way and fail-open when an inbox item is raised (contract-025 section 3).

pricing.description: 0.25.0. USD prices per million tokens, by model-id prefix; the longest key that is a prefix of a model's id applies. A model with no price makes a sum unpriced (null), never 0 (contract-025 section 4). The plugin writes no price itself.

budget.description: 0.25.0. Spend limits in USD, each above 0, checked at member start (contract-025 section 4). workTypes sets a tighter per-crew limit for a work type.

workTypes.description: 0.25.0. Per work type, a profile that may only tighten the built-in one: minProcess may only rise, stressTest and red may only become true. A loosening is reported by factory worktypes (contract-025 section 5).

intake.description: 0.25.0. Where factory intake reads work from (contract-025 section 6). Defaults: sources ["md"], queueFile docs/queue.md, ghLabel truss, claimTtlHours 24.

price.description: One model prefix's prices in USD per million tokens; fast applies to a row with speed fast.

longContext.description: 0.29.0. Rates for a request whose prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes) is over abovePromptTokens tokens, such as Claude Haiku 5.5 over 100,000. A fast row never uses them.

agentType.description: A full agent type: a project or built-in type, or plugin:name.

promptFile.description: A markdown file directly under .claude/truss/prompts/, relative to the repo root.
